author: N6rL
content:
Trigger: user has PDF files with random/opaque filenames (e.g. from arXiv fetching in prototype, or scanner output) and wants to know if alcanzai should rename/normalize them based on extracted metadata (title, authors, year from GROBID or provenance).

Design space:

OPTION A — Never rename. Preserve original filename as-is in provenance.raw_identifier. The canonical_id and job directory (UUID) are the stable handles; the original filename is just provenance. Simplest. Avoids any mutation of the user's filesystem outside .alcanzai/. Consistent with 'Rust owns all durable state' — the vault/projection is where human-readable names live, not the source file.

OPTION B — Rename in place on ingest. Source plugin renames the file to something like '{year}_{first_author}_{title_slug}.pdf' after metadata extraction. Familiar to users coming from Zotero/Mendeley. Problem: mutates user's filesystem, breaks any existing links/citations in notes, requires a rename-rollback on failure, and GROBID extraction happens in the Understanding layer (after ingestion) so you don't have the metadata yet when the file is first ingested.

OPTION C — Symlink or copy to a managed .alcanzai/files/ tree with normalized names, leaving originals untouched. Best of both worlds but adds complexity and doubles storage.

OPTION D — Don't rename files at all; let the Obsidian projection render a normalized title in the note frontmatter and filename. The vault note is named by extracted metadata; the source PDF is referenced by its job_id. This is the vault-as-projection approach — human-readable names live in the projection, not in the source filesystem.

Lean: Option D is most consistent with the architecture. The vault projection already owns 'what the human sees' — the note filename IS the normalized name. The source PDF stays where it is. The job directory is the addressable artifact. Worth a short design session before M1 implementation starts. Relates to: vault projection design, Source plugin interface (does Source.normalize() touch the filesystem?), and the question of whether alcanzai manages a file library or just indexes external files.
